spans.s:
भञ्ज् 1. भञ्ज्, cl. 10. P. भञ्जयति,
यितुम्, to speak; to shine; [cf. Hib.
faighim, ‘I speak, talk;’ faighle, faighleadh,
‘words, talk, conversation;’ faigh, ‘a prophet.’]

भञ्ज् 2. भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. भनक्ति, ब-
भञ्ज, भङ्क्ष्यति, अभाङ्क्षीत्,
भङ्क्तुम्, to break, fracture, break down, break
to pieces, shatter, split; to break into, make a
breach in (a fortress, with acc.); to interrupt, check,
arrest, suspend, foil, frustrate; to disappoint: Pass.
भज्यते, Aor. अभञ्जि, अभाजि, see Pāṇ.

: Caus. भञ्जयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबभञ्जत्:
Desid. बिभङ्क्षति: Intens. बम्भज्यते, बम्-
भङ्क्ति; [perhaps the original form was भ्रञ्ज्;
cf. Gr. ῥήγνυμι, ῥηγμίν, ῥαγή, perhaps also ἄγνυμι
Lat. frang-o: Goth. brak, ga-brika, ga-brak,
ga-brekum, brik-an: Angl. Sax. brak-an, brec-an:
Lettish braks, ‘fragile:’ Hib. brisim, ‘I break,
dismember, disunite;’ brit, ‘fraction;’ breadach,
‘broken.’]

भञ्जक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who breaks, break-
ing, a breaker; what breaks or severs, what divides
or destroys; (इका), f. breaking, (in comps. affixed to
the names of plants to denote particular games, cf.
उद्दालक-पुष्प-भ्˚, शाल-भ्˚.)

भञ्जत्, अन्, अती, अत्, breaking, breaking up, de-
stroying.

भञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, one who breaks, breaking,
a breaker, destroyer; one who checks or arrests, one
who frustrates or brings to nought; causing violent
pain; (अस्), m. falling to pieces or decay of the
teeth; (अम्), n. the act of breaking, destroying, de-
molishing, shattering; routing; paining, afflicting;
interrupting, checking, arresting, frustrating; remov-
ing, dispelling (a doubt, difficulty, &c.).
—भञ्-
जना-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain.

भञ्जनक, अस्, m. a particular disease of the
mouth, contortion of the lips and decay of the
teeth.
भञ्जरु, उस्, m. a tree growing near a temple.
भञ्जा, f. a N. of Durgā.

भञ्जिन्, ई, इनी, इ, breaking, removing, dispelling;
[cf. मद-भ्˚.]

भञ्जिपत्त्रिका भञ्जिपत्त्रिका, f. the plant
Salvinia Cucullata; [cf. फञ्जिपत्त्रिका.]
